1) Classify document as invoice:
- Document contains header "Rechnung" and invoice-like elements (Nummer, Datum, line items, MwSt, Nettobetrag, Gesamtsumme). No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" prominent. -> It's an invoice.

2) Locate Invoice.Date:
- Top right of page 1 shows "Datum 26.01.2024". Alternative dates (delivery dates) are line-item related (25.01.2024) but "Datum" is invoice issue date. -> Invoice.Date = "26.01.2024".

3) Locate Sender.VatId:
- On page 1 header: "VAT Registration n° ATU39103108" and repeated lines show "ATU39103108". -> Sender.VatId = "ATU39103108".

4) Determine VAT groups and rates:
- At bottom page 7: summary table shows "MwSt.-% 10,00 %", and line "10,00 % 1.805,54 ... 18.055,37 ... 19.860,91". No other VAT rates. -> single VAT rate = 10 (per rule: drop percent sign).

5) Extract Net.Amount and Vat.Amount:
- From same summary: "Gesamtsumme netto (EUR) 18.055,37" and "MwSt.-€ 1.805,54". Formats use comma as decimal separator. Preserve decimals as in input. -> Net.Amount = 18.055,37; Vat.Amount = 1.805,54.

6) Determine GrandTotal.Amount:
- Summary shows "Gesamtsumme brutto (EUR) 19.860,91". There's also an early-payment discounted total "Zahlung bis 25.02.2024 2,000 % EUR 19.463,69" but the invoice gross total is 19.860,91. -> GrandTotal.Amount = 19.860,91.

7) Verify consistency:
- Net (18.055,37) + Vat (1.805,54) = 19.860,91 matches GrandTotal. VAT rate 10 corresponds: 18.055,37 * 0.10 = 1.805,537 -> rounded to 1.805,54 as shown. All values consistent.

8) No missing inference:
- All required fields present explicitly in document; no guessing required.
